items.title: ConnectWise fixes Automate bug allowing AiTM update attacks
items.description: ConnectWise released a security update to address vulnerabilities, one of them with critical severity, in Automate product that could expose sensitive communications to interception and modification. [...]

items.title: American Airlines subsidiary Envoy confirms Oracle data theft attack
items.description: Envoy Air, a regional airline carrier owned by American Airlines, confirms that data was compromised from its Oracle E-Business Suite application after the Clop extortion gang listed American Airlines on its data leak site. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Disrupts Ransomware Campaign Abusing Azure Certificates
items.description: Microsoft revoked more than 200 digital certificates that threat actors used to sign fake Teams binaries that set the stage for Rhysida ransomware attacks.

items.title: Microsoft lifts more safeguard holds blocking Windows 11 updates
items.description: Microsoft has removed two more compatibility holds preventing customers from installing Windows 11 24H2 via Windows Update. [...]

items.title: Europol dismantles SIM box operation renting numbers for cybercrime
items.description: European law enforcement in an operation codenamed 'SIMCARTEL' has dismantled an illegal SIM-box service that enabled more than 3,200 fraud cases and caused at least 4.5 million euros in losses. [...]

items.title: AI Agent Security: Whose Responsibility Is It?
items.description: The shared responsibility model of data security, familiar from cloud deployments, is key to agentic services, but cybersecurity teams and corporate users often struggle with awareness and managing that risk.

items.title: Microsoft: Russia, China Increasingly Using AI to Escalate Cyberattacks on the US
items.description: The U.S. is the top target for cyberattacks, with criminals and foreign adversaries targeting companies, governments and organizations. The post Microsoft: Russia, China Increasingly Using AI to Escalate Cyberattacks on the US appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: AI Chat Data Is History’s Most Thorough Record of Enterprise Secrets, Secure it Wisely
items.description: AI interactions are becoming one of the most revealing records of human thinking; and we're only beginning to understand what that means for law enforcement, accountability, and privacy.
